user_story: As a user, I want the profile endpoint to return unauthorized when I am not logged in so that private data is protected.

positive.title: Verify profile endpoint returns unauthorized when user is not logged in
steps: Send a request to the profile endpoint without an authentication token.
positive.expected_result: The response status code is 401 Unauthorized.

negative.title: Verify profile endpoint returns unauthorized with an invalid token
steps: Send a request to the profile endpoint with an invalid authentication token.
negative.expected_result: The response status code is 401 Unauthorized.

edge.title: Verify profile endpoint handles requests with expired token correctly
steps: Send a request to the profile endpoint with an expired authentication token.
edge.expected_result: The response status code is 401 Unauthorized.
